info.title: Cutover synthetic equipment protocol
info.description: An original local simulation. Mutual TLS authenticates the adapter; a separate scenario certificate permits read-only evidence and test controls. Stable command identity and immutable payload enforce one accepted command. Acceptance and atomic physical completion are separate database transactions. This protocol does not connect real machinery.

put.description: Adapter certificate only. Same ID/payload returns retained status. Changed payload, world/generation or load precondition conflicts; no new command ID is created to escape a duplicate.

200.description: Retained command status; ACCEPTED is not completion

409.description: Immutable command, world or physical precondition conflict

503.description: Durability paused or controlled failure before acceptance

404.description: Absence with world ID, journal generation and completeHistory. Absence is resend proof only in the same retained world with complete history and no prior acceptance evidence.

200.description: World, generation, journal high-water, observation timestamp and site-scoped lanes
Execution ledger in increasing sequence order, up to the requested bound
Most recent 100 configurations with remaining count, activation/clear times and selector

post.description: Scenario certificate and explicit enabled configuration required. A null selector targets the next eligible command. STALE_STATUS and DUPLICATE_RESPONSE require an existing selector and retain its status snapshot; delayMillis delays activation. HOLD_EXECUTING persists an executing deadline; delayMillis must be 1000–60000. Other delays are 0–10000. BEFORE_ACCEPT responds 503 before acceptance; LOST_RESPONSE executes then delays; DELAY_RESPONSE delays the acceptance response while normal execution continues. HISTORY_GAP/WORLD_MISMATCH alter evidence only, never the actual world or physical ledger.

200.description: Remaining count set to zero; activation history and business data retained
Updated equipment observation; other lanes remain independent

problem.description: TLS handshake rejects an untrusted certificate; 403 certificate role denied; 404 absent or controls disabled; 409 conflict; 413 oversize; 422 invalid contract; 503 durability unavailable.
